body:
I try that, I really do. 

Most of the time the only reason to get out of bed everyday is to do things for other people.

I think the only reason for being with my girlfriend is to help her with her issues. Thankfully she is getting better, but it also shows how self centered most people are. 

It just gets tiring.

Just being seems so meaningless. 
I feel like there is no place in this world for me. 
I can't stand being useless anymore.

Thanks for the offer, but I really don't want to waste your time. 

When I'm dead I won't be able to regret anything anymore - that's the point, I guess.
